githubPermissionBasis.tokenScope: Dedicated bootstrap repository own GITHUB_TOKEN is repository-scoped
githubPermissionBasis.oldPackageBoundary: Existing success package must have no link, inheritance or Actions write/admin grant to bootstrap repository, established read-only before/after
githubPermissionBasis.firstCreation: GHCR first publication creates package; new package defaults private and workflow publication auto-links repository, but actual linkage must be read back
githubPermissionBasis.newPackageAdmin: Bootstrap publisher can obtain admin on NEWcandidate; acknowledged, never described as absence of candidate delete capability
githubPermissionBasis.normalHandoff: Candidate granular ACL after creation, disable inheritance/bootstrap access, wait completed job/token expiry; normal publisher non-owner Write-only, no old-package rights; owner admins explicitly acknowledged
githubPermissionBasis.emptyPackageCreationApi: Not found in official documented Packages API; do not invent an endpoint

design.seedMethod: Future separately approved exact-parent registry copy; no rebuild/relabel/digest change

limitations: Proof validators consume declared evidence; they do not independently query GitHub or grant permissions
Current draft is not executable and does not loosen the existing normal policy
The initial seed is the unchanged old parent, not the Vulkan candidate
Unknown or unauthorized404 never proves package absence
Actual GitHub ACLs and live package creation eligibility remain unverified
